The control panel seems to work for the most part, though when selecting any zwave device in the control panel list and clicking the "Home Assistant" tab, it says "No Hass Devices" which is incorrect.

review_comments:
Honestly, looking at this, I think this is incorrect (and also was incorrect as well).

This assumes the connected peer is the client, which doesn't have to be the case, this should already be processed by our middleware, and thus `request.remote` should contain the actual client IP.

At this point, it will forward a possible proxy IP address as the client.

Oh nevermind 🤦 
It's a proxy and tries to pass as is. Morning!
